answer_1.quote: UnifiedVisual-240K incorporates the following key features: First, the instructions may include both visual and textual information, encouraging holistic integration of multimodal context for accurate responses. Second, the responses may also consist of both visual and textual elements, requiring the model to excel in both textual reasoning and multimodal generation.
